issue_context.title: Add tests for the trace API
issue_context.body: We do not have any real tests for the trace API yet.
comments: For example there is no test to check that trace_categories are in sync with the defined categories. (#17397)

review_comments: The other option is to drop `trace_categories_len` and replace `OSSL_TRACE_CATEGORY_NUM == trace_categories_len` with `OSSL_TRACE_CATEGORY_NUM == OSSL_NELEM(trace_categories)` above.
